newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - dollars, lire and Can dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - dollars, lire and Can dlrs.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on dollars, Canadian dollars and lire.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY This trade offers a yield pick-up of around
eight basis points. Although Safeway is not officially rated it is treated in the market as A1. So the rating and maturity of the two bonds is similar. However the Safeway is more liquid.
STRATEGY This trade can currently be done for a yield

drop of around just 2.5 b.p. which represents best ever terms (average drop over the past six months has been almost 12 b.p.). The trade also has significant liquidity benefits, moving out of a $250 million deal into a $1.5 billion benchmark transaction and gives a cash takeout of over three points.
STRATEGY EIB 6.20 percent has become even more expensive

against the swap compared to last week. The spread against the swap has tightened from 43 b.p. through to around 59 b.p. through on the bid side. Over the last month it has outperformed the EIB 9.60 percent by around 70 b.p. in price terms.
This switch allows a 33 b.p. pick-up in yield while shortening duration. EIB 9.60 percent is also cheap at around 12 b.p. through the swap and around 13 b.p. through the BTP.
STRATEGY This switch is attractive as it allows the

investor to pick up around 12 b.p. in yield for a small increase in duration. DSL offers comparitive liquidity and is cheap against the swap and the BTP trading respectively at around nine b.p. through and 22 b.p. over.
STRATEGY Over the last month EIB 7.875 percent has

outperformed EIB 10.875 percent by approximately 100 b.p. in price terms. EIB 7.875 pct is expensive against the swap and the Btp trading respectively at around 36 b.p. and 17 b.p. through. The EIB 10.875 percent offers around a 19 b.p. pick up in yield and trades cheaply at nine b.p. through the swap.
STRATEGY This switch offers a yield pick-up of around 12
b.p. giving close to the two-year high of 14 b.p. The lower coupon on the buy-side means that the premium is considerably lower than the bond on the sell-side.
